verdict.rationale: Grafana documents dynamic, reusable dashboards with template variables shown as dropdowns. It offers a wide range of visualizations, from time series to heatmaps and 3D charts, extensible through panel plugins. Dashboards can be defined as version-controlled files for distribution, and users praise the newer panels, though some report rough edges with specific panels and legends. missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-product dashboard sharing (share links, snapshots, permissions), and community-reported friction with dashboard authoring and some visualization regressions (node graph datasource limits, legend/axis issues).

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Create dynamic & reusable dashboards with template variables that appear as dropdowns at the top of the dashboard.
The growing suite of Grafana visualizations, ranging from time series graphs to heatmaps to cutting-edge 3D charts, provide you several different ways to present your data within a panel
Panel plugins offer many different ways to visualize metrics and logs.
You can define data sources and dashboards using files that can be version controlled, making GitOps more natural.
